ArrowLoop 2.9.6 picks the target under an Encrypted or Compressed target from your saved targets, and fixes FTP targets that list hidden files and installs whose first start was cut off.

## ✨ Added

- **Pick the target a wrapper is built on.** Target to wrap on Encrypted, Compressed, Alias and the other targets built on another one lists your saved targets by name with their rclone ID, and a field below it takes a folder in that target. Merged and combined targets add theirs one row at a time, on the web and on the phone. A wrapper saved with a target's name instead of its ID opens with the right target picked and is saved right the next time. Thanks to @danpeig for the idea ([#288](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/288)).
- **The rclone remote ID on a target's form.** A saved target's form shows its rclone remote ID with a button that copies it, on the web and on the phone. Thanks to @danpeig for asking for it ([#288](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/288)).

## ⚡ Improved

- **New targets get an ID of their own.** A new target's rclone ID is random, like a job's, so a target renamed from SFTP to CERN Particle Accelerator no longer keeps an ID that says SFTP. Targets you already have keep their IDs, since jobs and wrapped targets point at them. Thanks to @danpeig for the report ([#290](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/290)).
- **A manual section on targets built on another target.** The manual explains how to set up Encrypted, Compressed and the others, how merged and combined targets work, and why a job points at the encrypted target and not at the folder under it. Thanks to @danpeig for asking ([#289](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/289)).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A job can be pointed at a new Encrypted, Compressed or Archive target.** Choose a folder answered "directory not found" for a wrapper whose folder did not exist yet, and kept Use this folder and New folder greyed out. Such a target now opens as empty, so you can pick it or make a folder in it. Thanks to @danpeig for the report ([#289](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/289)).
- **An FTP target that lists hidden files has nothing to do on the second run.** With List hidden files switched on, the server gave the folder's times only to the minute or the day and ArrowLoop took them as exact, so every run after the first left all files alone and said they had changed on the server while it ran. ArrowLoop now reads the folder and each file of such a target the same way. Thanks to @Franzl123 for the report ([#285](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/285)).
- **A first start that was cut off no longer blocks every start after it.** When ArrowLoop was closed or lost power during its very first start, `app.key` beside the configuration could stay empty, and every start after that stopped with "the key has to be 64 hexadecimal characters". ArrowLoop now writes the key in one step, and two copies that start at the same moment share one key. An `app.key` left empty gets a new key as long as nothing was sealed with the old one yet, such as a password, a paired device or a VPN login. If something was, the start says what needs the old key.

## 🌐 Translations

- **The target picker in every language.** Its fields, the ID row and their hints are in all 42 languages of the app. Thanks to @danpeig for [#288](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/288) and [#290](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/arrowloop/issues/290), which brought them.
